essence: The verse names the arising of mantra mixture from unworthy association.
The verse states variation in the weight of sin among faults.
For the wiping away of every stain, the teacher prescribes expiation.
Alternatively, japa of the teacher's name is remembered for all sins.
Improper conduct is consumed in the fire of expiation.
